info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Trials-v5-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Trial Management API allows users to access and manage trial subscriptions for streaming services. This endpoint provides a list of available trial subscriptions, enabling consumers to view options and details relevant to their streaming experience. Typically utilized by developers integrating subscription features into their applications, this API serves to enhance user engagement and provide trial opportunities. Ideal for onboarding users and increasing retention, it plays a crucial role in the subscription lifecycle.

get.description: Fetches the details of trial subscriptions available in the system. This endpoint allows you to view the characteristics and status of trial subscriptions for the users.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve trial subscription information. Ensure that the provided data conforms to the expected schema for successful processing.

201.description: Resource successfully created, indicating the trial subscription is active.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the GET operation on subscriptions' trial.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsResponse.title: Trial Subscription Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the subscription request.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the trial subscription.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context or information about the operation.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsResponse.description: Response object containing the details of a trial subscription operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the subscription.
